result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with no critical issues. One minor visual issue was identified.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, cutting off mid-word ('Piccol' instead of the full name), which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to ensure truncated text ends with '...' rather than cutting off mid-word, or increase the card width to accommodate longer names.
